kts.model.description: Language model for answer generation. 'auto' uses your active Copilot model.

kts.models.critiqueModel.description: Model used for the Critique loop (gap detection per round). Can be a lighter model than the generation model to save cost and time.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI GPT-4o Mini — good enough for query expansion
kts.models.queryExpansionModel.description: Model used for multi-query expansion (generating variant queries). A lighter model is usually sufficient here.

kts.rag.multiQuery.enabledForLegal.description: [Legal docs] Generate LLM query variants before retrieval. Off by default — HyDE already handles vocabulary bridging for legal. Enable to improve recall at the cost of ~2s extra latency (1 LLM call).

kts.rag.multiQuery.enabledForNonLegal.description: [Non-legal / guides] Generate LLM query variants before retrieval. Off by default for ≤5s latency target. Enable for troubleshooting queries with many synonyms, adds ~2s.

kts.rag.multiQuery.variants.description: Number of additional query variants to generate (1 = just original query, 2 = original + 1 variant). Higher values improve recall but add latency.

kts.rag.hyde.enabledForLegal.description: [Legal docs] HyDE: generate a hypothetical document, then embed it for retrieval. Off by default for ≤10s target (saves 1–3s LLM call inside backend). Enable for deep legal analysis where vocabulary gap between query and clause language is a concern.

kts.rag.hyde.enabledForNonLegal.description: [Non-legal / guides] HyDE: generates a hypothetical answer before retrieval. Less useful when vocabulary already matches (guides, manuals). Recommended OFF to save latency.

kts.retrieval.legal.itemsTopK.description: [Legal docs] Max clause/item nodes fetched from the knowledge graph per query. Default 20 targets ≤10s. Raise to 60 for maximum precision (adds ~0.5s).

kts.retrieval.legal.sectionsTopK.description: [Legal docs] Max section chunks fetched from the vector store per query. Default 8 targets ≤10s; raise to 20 for maximum coverage.

kts.retrieval.nonLegal.itemsTopK.description: [Non-legal / guides] Max item nodes fetched from the knowledge graph per query. Default 12 targets ≤5s. Raise to 30 for broader coverage.

kts.retrieval.nonLegal.sectionsTopK.description: [Non-legal / guides] Max section chunks fetched from the vector store per query. Default 5 targets ≤5s.

kts.retrieval.maxContextChunks.description: Maximum chunks passed to the LLM context window. Capped by token budget. Higher = more context, higher cost per generation call.

kts.retrieval.crossEncoder.enabled.description: Run a cross-encoder model to rerank retrieved candidates before sending to LLM. Significantly improves precision. Small latency cost (~200ms). Recommended: always ON.

kts.retrieval.crossEncoder.poolSizeLegal.description: [Legal docs] How many candidates the cross-encoder scores. Default 20 matches itemsTopK for ≤10s target. Raise to 60 for maximum reranking precision.

kts.retrieval.bm25.enabled.description: Blend BM25 keyword search with vector (embedding) search using Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Dramatically improves recall for exact term matches (error codes, part numbers, defined terms). Recommended: always ON.

kts.retrieval.bm25.weight.description: Weight given to the BM25 lane in RRF fusion (vector weight = 1 − this). 0.4 means 40% keyword, 60% vector. Increase for exact-match heavy corpora.

kts.retrieval.bm25.k1.description: BM25 term-frequency saturation. Higher = more weight on term frequency before saturation. Default 1.5 is standard for most corpora.

kts.retrieval.bm25.b.description: BM25 document-length normalization. 0 = no normalization, 1 = full normalization. 0.75 is the standard default.

kts.critique.enabledForLegal.description: [Legal docs] Run the directed-critique loop: after initial generation, the system checks pre-indexed questions one by one. Catches missed obligations, defined terms, and cross-references. High accuracy, multiple LLM calls.

kts.critique.enabledForNonLegal.description: [Non-legal / guides] Run the directed-critique loop. Off by default for ≤5s target — adds 1–3 LLM calls. Enable for complex guides where coverage gaps matter.

kts.critique.maxRoundsLegal.description: [Legal docs] Maximum critique-fix cycles. Default 1 for ≤10s target. Raise to 3 for high-stakes analysis (adds ~10–20s per extra round).

kts.critique.maxRoundsNonLegal.description: [Non-legal / guides] Maximum critique rounds. 1 round is usually enough for guides where gaps are rare. Increasing saves little accuracy but adds latency.

kts.critique.restartOnGap.description: After fixing a gap, restart critique from question 1 (ensures fixed answer is re-checked from scratch). Most expensive option — doubles critique time. Recommended OFF for non-legal. ON only for high-stakes legal analysis.

kts.critique.confidenceExit.description: Stop the critique loop early when confidence score exceeds this threshold. 0.9 = exit when 90% confident all questions are answered. Lower to run more rounds; raise to exit sooner.

kts.critique.maxQuestionsPerRound.description: Maximum critique questions evaluated per round. Default 3 for ≤10s legal target (each question = ~1 LLM call). Raise to 10–25 for comprehensive legal coverage at higher latency.

kts.crag.enabledForLegal.description: [Legal docs] CRAG: verify each factual claim after generation. Off by default for ≤10s target (saves 5–20 LLM calls). Enable for high-stakes legal work where hallucination prevention is critical.

kts.crag.enabledForNonLegal.description: [Non-legal / guides] CRAG for guides. Off by default for ≤5s target. Enable when procedure accuracy is critical and you can tolerate 10–30s extra latency.

kts.crag.maxClaims.description: Maximum claims to verify when CRAG is enabled. Default 5 minimises latency. Raise to 15–20 for thorough legal claim coverage.

kts.crag.evidenceTopK.description: Number of evidence chunks retrieved to verify each claim. 5 is usually sufficient; increase for domains with scattered evidence.

kts.crag.allowBackendReRetrieval.description: When a claim lacks evidence in the initial chunks, re-query the backend. Off by default — each re-query = 1 cold process spawn (~1–2s). Enable only if claim coverage is more important than latency.

kts.crag.dropContradicted.description: Remove claims that are directly contradicted by source documents. Recommended ON to prevent false information from appearing in answers.

kts.crag.flagNoEvidence.description: Mark claims that have no supporting evidence (neither verified nor contradicted) so the user knows which parts are unsubstantiated.

kts.phase19.tripleStoreEnabled.description: [Non-legal] Use three parallel vector stores (error-boundary, sentence-level, structure-aware) for non-legal documents. Each gives a different view of the same content — unified reranking picks the best. Higher accuracy, 3× storage.

kts.phase19.errorBoundaryChunking.description: [Non-legal] Store 1: chunk at error code and procedure boundaries. Gives precise, self-contained error resolution chunks. Essential for troubleshooting guides.

kts.phase19.sentenceLevelChunking.description: [Non-legal] Store 2: small sentence-level chunks (~200 chars). Best for pinpoint factual lookups. Lower recall but very high precision for exact fact retrieval.

kts.phase19.structureAwareChunking.description: [Non-legal] Store 3: structure-aware chunks that respect headers and list boundaries (~1500 chars). Best for conceptual questions. Balances coverage and precision.

kts.phase19.troubleshootingGraphEnabled.description: [Non-legal] Build a dedicated troubleshooting graph at ingest time (symptom → cause → resolution nodes). Enables graph-walk for multi-step diagnostic queries. Disable to reduce ingest time.

kts.chunking.legalChunkSize.description: [Legal docs] Target characters per chunk for legal/governing documents. Larger chunks preserve full clause context but cost more tokens per LLM call. 3000 chars ≈ 750 tokens.

kts.chunking.legalChunkOverlap.description: [Legal docs] Character overlap between consecutive legal chunks. Prevents clause boundaries from being split across chunks.

kts.chunking.nonLegalChunkSize.description: [Non-legal / guides] Target characters per chunk for guides and manuals. Smaller chunks = more precise retrieval for procedural steps. 1000 chars ≈ 250 tokens.

kts.chunking.nonLegalChunkOverlap.description: [Non-legal / guides] Character overlap between consecutive non-legal chunks.

kts.chunking.cchEnabled.description: Contextual Chunk Headers: prepend [DOC: | TYPE: | SECTION:] metadata to each chunk before embedding. Dramatically improves retrieval precision by giving the embedding model document context. Recommended: always ON.

kts.context.maxChunksInPrompt.description: Hard cap on chunks passed to the LLM prompt. Default 20 targets fastest generation (fewer input tokens). Raise to 40–60 for comprehensive multi-section legal answers at the cost of extra latency.

kts.context.tokenBudgetUtilization.description: Fraction of the model's context window used for retrieved context (0.8 = 80%). The remaining 20% is reserved for the prompt, query, and response. Reduce if you get 'context too long' errors.

kts.context.reservedTokens.description: Tokens unconditionally reserved for the system prompt, query text, follow-up questions, and response generation. Not available for retrieved context.
